entities.summary: Bandja Sy is a Malian-French professional basketball player for CSM Oradea of the Liga Națională. Standing at 2.05 m, he plays at the power forward and center positions. After playing four years of college basketball at New Mexico State, Sy entered the 2013 NBA draft, but he was not selected in the draft's two rounds. He is the brother of Amara Sy.
